# EngineRadialBarChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasEngineRadialBarChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineRadialBarChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineRadialBarChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasEngineRadialBarChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartEngineElement`](UltraCanvasChartEngineElement.md) → [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Any of the charts above **on the chart engine** — themes, measured layout, solved labels, tooltips, Vertical / Horizontal / Polar — compared with the legacy ones on the demo's *Chart Engine Comparison* page (`UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md`)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasEngineCharts](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasEngineCharts.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasEngineRadialBarChart> CreateEngineRadialBarChart( const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasEngineRadialBarChart(const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `EngineRadialBarStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Bars` | thick rays, thickness derived from the angular slot |
| `Lines` | thin uniform rays (the spoke / "radial line" look) |

| Value | Meaning |

### enum `EngineRadialBarNormalization`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Global` | one range across every series (comparable lengths) |
| `PerSeries` | each series scales to its own maximum |
